evidence: Reasoned through each floor case against the frozen bytes. Blank page / no server: test.sh:68-70 exits with the pre-written zero record if /app/server.js is absent and :123-125 if HTTP never answers; render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:15 all_pass, :23) fails a blank/error page. Static mock and seed copy: gates/constraints/judge.toml:15 all_pass with cw_shared_saved_record (:31-32) requiring a typed/pasted new snippet to Save, survive full origin-storage clearing (app_context.md:28) and two reloads with exact title/filename/source, so a static, read-only, localStorage-only or seed-copied page fails the gate; score.py:41-48 then zeroes reward and test.sh:218-221 skips the scored suite. Refusing submission: Save is refused so the same gate fails; scored criteria also carry positive controls (e.g. cw_dynamic_code_refused :330-333 harmless control, cw_stale_save_refused :348-351 A's accepted Save, cw_format_error_keeps_draft :204-207 valid-format control) so a do-nothing/refuse-everything app cannot farm negatives. Keyword stuffing: every one of the five prompts is browser-only with the untrusted-submission line and forbids reading implementation files, so text in the page cannot satisfy behavioral steps. Even a stronger mock that passes both gates (own typing surface + in-memory server save) must exceed the functional floor 0.05 of 59 weight (scoring.toml:10-11, score.py:47-48) before polish/visual (0.4 mass) count, and polish criteria themselves require working Format/Undo/Save/Run. Off-origin/CDN fetches are explicitly allowed in all prompts, consistent with the note. scoring.toml, score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template. Measured support: v15 hosted nop reward.json = 0 with no_op=1 (hash verified; same template test.sh/score.py); no configured-judge run of a static mock/seed copy exists for v16, but this row's verification method is reasoning and the zeroing path is deterministic code, not judge discretion, for every listed floor case except the in-page mock with real server save (which is no longer a shell).
